scope: All 89 reference points, all 77 destination coordinates, and every climate factor. Agency routes reviewed for the 45 previously grid-only destinations; source availability research is not exhaustive.

agencyReviews.name: London
agencyReviews.agency: UK Met Office / CEDA MIDAS Open
agencyReviews.note: MIDAS Open offers daily station observations, but its official catalogue requires a registered CEDA account and login. No authenticated download or qualifying central-London series was obtained.

agencyReviews.name: Rome
agencyReviews.note: SCIA documents downloadable daily station time series and metadata, but the daily station and time-series links currently lead to its maintenance page. A qualifying Rome daily baseline was not obtained; no registration or payment requirement was verified.

agencyReviews.name: Athens
agencyReviews.note: Accepted Thissio daily observations: all 10,958 baseline days for both temperature and rainfall; 1.45 km from the reference point and 8 m higher. Official metadata documents no station relocations. No per-record quality flags are supplied; instrument changes and observation-day timing are disclosed.

agencyReviews.name: Santorini
agencyReviews.note: HNMS's official service portal routes raw meteorological and climate data through an application and normally a fee, with specified research/public-sector exemptions. Its public climate page supplies summaries; no qualifying Santorini daily 1991–2020 baseline was obtained.

agencyReviews.name: Dubrovnik
agencyReviews.note: DHMZ provides an explicit meteorological-data request form and states delivery follows an offer and payment, with academic/research exceptions. Its public climate tables are monthly values and extremes, which cannot replace the daily distributions required here.

agencyReviews.name: Prague
agencyReviews.note: Accepted Praha Karlov public daily CSVs after excluding every quality code except Good. Lowest calendar-month coverage is 86.32% for paired temperature and 88.78% for rainfall. Both documented station positions pass 15 km/150 m limits; the 2003 location change is retained in provenance.

agencyReviews.name: Istanbul
agencyReviews.note: MGM's official archive route is the MEVBİS data-ordering system, listed under paid products with payment and order instructions. No order was placed and no qualifying Istanbul daily baseline was obtained.

agencyReviews.name: Marrakech
agencyReviews.agency: Direction Générale de la Météorologie, Morocco
agencyReviews.note: DGM confirms it provides daily station temperature and rainfall time series as climate services. The reviewed page supplied no public daily download or explicit access/fee requirement; a qualifying Marrakech baseline remains unverified.

agencyReviews.name: Cairo
agencyReviews.note: The official site was checked, but no public historical daily station download or explicit data-request/access requirement was verified. This is an unresolved source search, not evidence that observations are unavailable.

agencyReviews.name: Petra
agencyReviews.note: The official site offers climate averages and records, but no qualifying nearby daily 1991–2020 archive or explicit historical-data access requirement was verified. Monthly averages cannot supply the model's temperature distribution.

agencyReviews.name: Dubai
agencyReviews.note: NCM lists daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall among its services and publishes current daily station reports. A public 1991–2020 daily archive and any required registration/request process were not verified.

agencyReviews.name: Tokyo
agencyReviews.note: Precipitation imported from the complete-quality daily export: at least 99.89% of baseline days in every calendar month. Temperature stays grid: the agency marks a homogeneity break at the 2014-12-02 Otemachi–Kitanomaru move, provides no daily adjustment, and neither segment alone meets the unchanged 1991–2020 policy.

agencyReviews.name: Kyoto
agencyReviews.note: Temperature and precipitation imported from the official 1991–2020 daily export using only complete quality code 8. Every month exceeds 99.67% coverage. Station 47759 is 3.51 km from the reference point, with a 4.2 m elevation difference; the record retains one agency homogeneity segment.

agencyReviews.name: Seoul
agencyReviews.note: Temperature imported from 60 public annual daily tables for Songwol-dong station 108; every calendar month exceeds 99.89% coverage. These reference tables provide no per-record quality codes. Numeric ASOS observations have an attribution licence. Precipitation stays grid because blank rain cells cannot safely be treated as dry days.

agencyReviews.name: Beijing
agencyReviews.agency: China Meteorological Administration / National Meteorological Information Centre
agencyReviews.note: The official data network and registration route were located, but an eligible Beijing station's 1991–2020 daily temperature/precipitation export and station history were not verified. Failed public-page retrieval does not establish a payment or access requirement; both factors remain grid.

agencyReviews.name: Bangkok
agencyReviews.note: TMD directs historical meteorological/statistical data enquiries to its registered-user data-request service. No 1991–2020 daily station export was retrieved for this reference point; station location/history, quality flags and coverage still require verification. No request or payment was submitted.

agencyReviews.name: Phuket
agencyReviews.note: TMD directs historical meteorological/statistical data enquiries to its registered-user data-request service. No 1991–2020 daily station export was retrieved for this reference point; station location/history, quality flags and coverage still require verification. No request or payment was submitted.

agencyReviews.name: Chiang Mai
agencyReviews.note: TMD directs historical meteorological/statistical data enquiries to its registered-user data-request service. No 1991–2020 daily station export was retrieved for this reference point; station location/history, quality flags and coverage still require verification. No request or payment was submitted.

agencyReviews.name: Hanoi
agencyReviews.agency: Viet Nam Meteorological and Hydrological Administration
agencyReviews.note: The agency says historical hourly rainfall is supplied on request through regional offices or its information/data centre; commercial-use fees may apply. This confirms a rainfall request route, not a complete temperature archive. No eligible 1991–2020 daily temperature/precipitation station record was verified.

agencyReviews.name: Hoi An
agencyReviews.agency: Viet Nam Meteorological and Hydrological Administration
agencyReviews.note: The agency says historical hourly rainfall is supplied on request through regional offices or its information/data centre; commercial-use fees may apply. This confirms a rainfall request route, not a complete temperature archive. No eligible 1991–2020 daily temperature/precipitation station record was verified.

agencyReviews.name: Siem Reap
agencyReviews.note: The official climatology page was checked, but no downloadable 1991–2020 daily temperature/precipitation archive or station history was verified for the Siem Reap reference point. Agency access and data-request requirements were not confirmed; both factors remain grid.

agencyReviews.name: Bali
agencyReviews.note: BMKG Data Online presents a sign-in and registration gate for its data service. No authenticated Denpasar daily record was accessed. The 1991–2020 station history, reference-point eligibility and completeness remain unverified; no account was created.

agencyReviews.name: Maldives
agencyReviews.note: The current agency form explicitly offers daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall as raw CSV, with identity/contact details and a reason for requesting data. It warns that another island's data may be substituted when the requested island is unavailable; any returned station must still pass the existing distance/elevation screen. No request was submitted.

agencyReviews.name: Goa
agencyReviews.note: IMD's Data Supply Portal explicitly requires account registration, email verification and identity/undertaking documentation, followed by an online data request and any applicable charges. No account or request was created. Station representativeness still needs verification against the unchanged inland Goa reference point.

agencyReviews.name: Delhi
agencyReviews.note: IMD's Data Supply Portal explicitly requires account registration, email verification and identity/undertaking documentation, followed by an online data request and any applicable charges. No account or request was created; no qualifying 1991–2020 daily station export has been audited.

agencyReviews.name: Kathmandu
agencyReviews.note: DHM publishes a meteorological data request form, procurement process, price schedule and payment procedure for historical observations. No request or payment was made. Daily station values, missing-data flags and baseline coverage remain unaudited.

agencyReviews.name: Colombo
agencyReviews.note: The meteorological-service portal could not be retrieved in this pass. The official Department of Agriculture also has a meteorological-data request page, but it does not verify a Colombo station or a 1991–2020 daily export. No account, fee or mandatory request is inferred from these incomplete checks.

agencyReviews.name: Queenstown
agencyReviews.note: NIWA lists Queenstown station 5446 at −45.03476, 168.66364 and 322 m, close to the unchanged reference point, with a long historical daily record. The actual station-file page requires login to view purchase options. Public metadata alone does not establish valid daily values, licensing or 1991–2020 completeness.

agencyReviews.name: Cape Cod
agencyReviews.agency: NOAA / National Centers for Environmental Information
agencyReviews.note: Nearby Hyannis station USC00193821 is 0.64 km from the unchanged reference point, but its weakest calendar-month coverage is 74.73% for paired temperatures and 73.33% for precipitation. Both fail the existing 80% baseline-day requirement.

agencyReviews.name: Cancún
agencyReviews.note: Station 23155, Cancún, is 3.10 km away and 3 m lower. Official dated daily observations pass the unchanged policy for both variables; minimum monthly coverage is 93.01% for temperature and 89.98% for precipitation. NULO values are excluded. The archive supplies no per-record QC flags.

agencyReviews.name: Mexico City
agencyReviews.note: Station 09048, Tacubaya Central, is 7.53 km away and 70.6 m higher. Official dated daily observations pass the unchanged policy for both variables; minimum monthly coverage is 86.67% for temperature and 90.00% for precipitation. NULO values are excluded. The archive supplies no per-record QC flags.

agencyReviews.name: San José
agencyReviews.note: IMN explicitly directs detailed station-data requests through its services form. Its current instructions describe a follow-up letter or quotation for non-academic requests. No request was submitted, and a qualifying 1991–2020 station export has not been audited.

agencyReviews.name: Havana
agencyReviews.note: The official INSMET portal and its climate/report links were checked. A dated daily 1991–2020 station archive and its access procedure were not verified; this does not establish that a request or account is required.

agencyReviews.name: Aruba
agencyReviews.note: The agency publishes 1991–2020 normals and annual climate summaries. The inspected 1991 file contains monthly averages and rain-day counts, not individual daily readings, so it cannot support the temperature-range scoring distribution. A historical daily export remains unverified.

agencyReviews.name: Cartagena
agencyReviews.note: IDEAM documents its DHIME citizen portal for station-data consultation and download. The portal returned an unsupported-browser page during this pass; no dated Cartagena export, approval-level flags or baseline coverage were verified. No account requirement is inferred from that rendering failure.

agencyReviews.name: Galápagos
agencyReviews.note: Puerto Ayora's operator-published daily CSV is from a station 0.92 km away and 9 m lower. All 2020 minimum temperatures are excluded because the operator warns of 2020–2021 instrument errors. Both variables still pass the unchanged policy: minimum monthly coverage 86.33% temperature and 96.67% precipitation. No per-record QC flags are supplied. Source and derived monthly summaries are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: attribution, noncommercial use and share-alike terms apply.

agencyReviews.name: Cusco
agencyReviews.note: SENAMHI exposes a historical station-download map and a separate registration workflow requesting identity and emailed credentials. A qualifying Cusco station export and whether that workflow is currently mandatory for the export were not verified; no station record was imported.

agencyReviews.name: Rio de Janeiro
agencyReviews.note: INMET's BDMEP conventional-station archive explicitly requires an email request, confirmation link, and subsequent download link sent by email. The immediate annual automatic-station ZIP route starts in 2000 and cannot supply the required 1991–2000 decade coverage by itself. No email request was submitted.

agencyReviews.name: Buenos Aires
agencyReviews.note: SMN's public open-data page links a complete daily 1991–2020 archive, but fetching the linked RAR returned HTTP 403 in this pass. The archive's station coordinates, missing/QC conventions and daily coverage have not been audited. This retrieval failure is not evidence of an account or payment requirement. A browser attempt also stopped at Cloudflare security verification without reaching the archive; no challenge was solved or bypassed, and no account or payment requirement is inferred.

agencyReviews.name: Patagonia
agencyReviews.note: SMN's public open-data page links a daily 1991–2020 archive, but its RAR returned HTTP 403 in this pass. Coverage and a station within 15 km / 150 m of the existing El Calafate-area reference point remain unverified. The reference point was not moved to an airport or another Patagonian location. A browser attempt also stopped at Cloudflare security verification without reaching the archive; no challenge was solved or bypassed, and no account or payment requirement is inferred.

agencyReviews.name: Cape Town
agencyReviews.note: SAWS publishes a specific Climate Data Request contact and lists historical climate data as a commercial service. Its public Recent Climate page contains current reports, not a qualifying 1991–2020 daily archive near central Cape Town. A request/quote is the verified next route; no fee amount or guaranteed station coverage is claimed.

agencyReviews.name: Serengeti
agencyReviews.note: TMA confirms it collects and archives station rainfall and temperature and supplies climate information. No public daily baseline near the Ikoma reference area or explicit access/request requirement was verified.

agencyReviews.name: Zanzibar
agencyReviews.note: TMA's climate service is verified, but no public daily 1991–2020 station baseline near Zanzibar City or explicit access/request requirement was verified. The existing nearby NOAA series does not meet the unchanged coverage rules.

agencyReviews.name: Victoria Falls
agencyReviews.note: The official climate-services page offers forecasts, climate information and a contact route. It does not establish a downloadable daily baseline or a specific historical-data access requirement; qualifying station observations remain unverified.

agencyReviews.name: Mauritius
agencyReviews.note: MMS explicitly holds daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall records and directs climate-data requests to the agency. It states charges apply for extraction, preparation and verification. Coverage and a suitable station near the Port Louis reference point still require verification; no request or payment was made.

findings.detail: Tenerife now explicitly represents El Médano coast; regional names show their reference areas. Remaining grid elevation differences >=300m are flagged.
Searchable Data audit dialog exposes all 77 destinations independently of ranking, home exclusion and Domestic/International filters; marker labels include provenance.
NOAA provenance uses file retrieval dates and hashes; no cached global revision is attributed to independently refreshed files.
Frequent precipitation replaces Very rainy; total precipitation includes snow-water equivalent.
Every source file and the Banff station succession are inspectable, with explicit manifest hash scope.

limitations: No station guarantees identical beach, slope or valley exposure.
Agency quality systems differ; Singapore supplies no per-record quality flag.
Banff precipitation remains a grid because observed-only coverage fails.
NIWA Queenstown requires agency access; Nepal DHM requires a data request; a verified Cusco daily baseline was not obtained.
No climate trend homogenization; 1991–2020 describes historical conditions, not a future forecast.
Crowd and travel factors remain disclosed estimates.
